verdict.rationale: v0 docs describe Project-level integrations with databases like Neon (Postgres) and Upstash (Redis) plus Supabase, and claim v0 'connects to databases as it builds,' suggesting in-builder wiring. However, this appears to be connecting to externally-provisioned services rather than full in-app database provisioning, and no hands-on community evidence confirms a seamless zero-leave experience.
